headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw three touchdown passes to Tyler Eifert and played lead blocker on Mohamed Sanu's reverse Thursday night, keeping the Cincinnati Bengals unbeaten with a 31-10 victory over the Cl
headlines.shortLinkText: Eifert scores 3 TDs, Bengals 8-0 after blowout

headlines.description: Sammy Watkins had a career-best 168 yards receiving and a touchdown, and rookie running back Karlos Williams scored twice in leading the Bills to a 33-11 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watkins sparks Bills to 33-17 win over Dolphins

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson rushed for 125 yards on 29 carries for Minnesota, helping set up Blair Walsh's 40-yard field goal in overtime that lifted the Vikings a 21-18 victory over the St. Louis Rams on Su
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings lose Bridgewater, beat Rams 21-18 in OT

events.name: Washington Redskins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: It was more than 10 minutes into the game and the score was already lopsided.
headlines.shortLinkText: Early turnovers help Patriots to 27-10 win over Washington

events.name: Tennessee Titans at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Rookie Marcus Mariota passed for 371 yards and four touchdowns and the Tennessee Titans snapped a six-game skid with a 34-28 overtime victory against the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariota, Titans beat Saints in overtime 34-28

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at New York Jets

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick threw two touchdown passes while playing with a torn ligament in his left thumb, Chris Ivory ran for two scores and the Jets took advantage of late mistakes by the Jaguars.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fitzpatrick, Ivory lead Jets to 28-23 victory over Jaguars

headlines.description: Chris Boswell hit an 18-yard field goal with 2 seconds left to lift the Pittsburgh Steelers to a 38-35 win over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers beat Raiders 38-35 but lose Roethlisberger

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for three touchdowns and ran for another score, and the Panthers took an important step toward best record in the NFC once the playoffs arrive with a 37-29 win over the Packers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers stay unbeaten as Newton sinks Packers

headlines.description: Blaine Gabbert threw a pair of second-quarter touchdown passes to Garrett Celek, and the undermanned San Francisco 49ers held on to beat the Atlanta Falcons 17-16 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Promoted backup Blaine Gabbert leads 49ers past Falcons

events.name: New York Giants at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Eli Manning threw for 213 yards and two touchdowns in helping the first-place Giants rebound from last week's road debacle at New Orleans with a 32-18 victory over the Buccaneers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning throws for 2 TDs, Giants hold off Buccaneers

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw two touchdown passes and Adam Vinatieri made a tiebreaking 55-yard field goal with 6:13 to play as Indianapolis earned a surprising 27-24 victory over Denver.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts hand Broncos 1st loss, halt Peyton's chase

headlines.description: Sam Bradford threw a 41-yard touchdown pass to Jordan Matthews and the Philadelphia Eagles sent the Dallas Cowboys to their longest losing streak in 26 years with a 33-27 victory in overtime.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles hand Cowboys sixth straight loss, 33-27 in OT

events.name: Chicago Bears at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Zach Miller made a one-handed grab on a 25-yard touchdown pass from Jay Cutler with 3:19 to go, and the Chicago Bears beat the San Diego Chargers 22-19 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miller's circus-catch touchdown caps Bears' rally
